result.instructions:
Touchline explains a live (synthetic, fictional) football match. Use list_matches first, then the
other tools with a session id ('demo' is always running). Quote numbers exactly as the tools return them and
cite event IDs like E01837 when you explain why something happened.

tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: Live matches: session id, clubs, score and minute.

tools.name: get_scoreboard
tools.description: Score, minute, possession, xG, shots, win probability, momentum and whether the game is in control or chaos.

tools.name: get_key_moments
tools.description: The latest verified moments with why they mattered, newest last. kind filters (goal, momentum, phase, press, story_duel...).

tools.name: explain_event
tools.description: Every derived fact for one event: xG, pass difficulty, threat added, win-probability change.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: One player's match: passes and accuracy, pass difficulty, xG, threat added, top speed, distance, rating.

tools.name: get_team_report
tools.description: Tactical picture for 'home' or 'away': pressing (PPDA), high turnovers, xG, shots, possession.

tools.name: get_recap
tools.description: The match story so far (half-time or full-time recap) for a casual fan or an analyst, in a language.

tools.name: what_if
tools.description:
Counterfactual: replay the rest of the match 1,000 times with one thing changed (a goal ruled out, a red card
        not given, an extra goal). Call with no scenario to list the options for this match.

tools.name: ask_analyst
tools.description: Ask Touchline's analyst agent anything about the match; the answer cites event IDs.
